title: Developer Tools Playtest — notes and action list
content:
Meeting: Dev Tools Playtest — internal dogfooding session
Date: 2026-11-11
Attendees: Maya (owner), Ethan, Priya, Liam, Sara, + 4 engineers from serving-runtime (joined for the demo)
Purpose: run the new SDK quickstart/samples end-to-end on mac/linux, stress the CLI install flow, validate sample app templates, and capture first-pass UX issues before broader beta.

Summary/high-level takeaways:
- CLI install is still the single biggest friction: default Python venv vs pipx confusion, and the mac arm64 wheel fallback causes a lot of cryptic pip output. ~25% of testers hit issues on first try.
- Auth UX: the inline browser flow for private deployments worked for most, but service-account key path examples in the docs are inconsistent with the samples repo (env var names differ).
- Samples: chatbot template is generally solid; the retrieval-augmented search sample fails on small corpora due to an unhandled empty-index edge case.
- Telemetry/logging: devs remarked that initial logs show too much internal debug noise; we should add a flag to toggle verbose SDK logs.
- Onboarding doc gaps: OS-specific steps (brew vs apt) are mixed into a single section; testers wanted a short TL;DR checklist at the top.

What we tested (actions run):
- Fresh checkout of samples repo -> npm install && python -m venv -> sdk install -> run quickstart-chatbot (mac/linux)
- CLI auth: browser flow and SA key flow
- Template update: swapped model to a quantized variant to verify model pinning and fallback
- Local dev loop: live reload + env var changes

Bugs / Observations (short):
- BUG-001: pip error when arm64 wheel not available, fallback tries to build from source and fails (mac M1). Repro: macOS 13.4 + Python3.10.
- BUG-002: samples/retrieval/indexer.py throws IndexEmptyError when corpus length == 0 (fix: guard and helpful message).
- UX-001: docs use REDWOOD_API_KEY and SAMPLE_API_KEY interchangeably -> confuses new users.
- PERF-001: cold start for a local quickstart container image ~8s on dev laptop; acceptable but note for README.

Decisions / short-term proposals:
- Docs: add a one-page TL;DR checklist per OS and an explicit auth quick reference. Owner: Priya. Due: 2026-11-18.
- SDK: add --verbose and --quiet flags to CLI and reduce default log noise. Owner: Ethan. PR target: #482 but may need follow-up.
- Samples: patch retrieval sample to handle empty corpora + add unit test. Owner: Liam. Due: 2026-11-15.
- Install: create troubleshooting subsection titled "common install failures" with copy/paste fixes for mac M1. Owner: Maya. Due: 2026-11-17.

Open questions / follow-ups:
- How aggressively do we want the CLI to auto-detect Python envs vs recommending pipx? (tradeoff: helpful vs surprising behavior).
- Telemetry: which dev-only logs can be safely removed vs moved behind a flag? Need input from serving-runtime on what is required for debugging production issues.
- Beta rollout: after fixes, run a 2-week external dogfood with 10 partner teams — agree on success metrics (install success %, completion of quickstart, time-to-first-inference).

Metrics we captured during session (informal):
- 12 total testers (internal)
- Install success first-run: 9/12 (75%)
- Time-to-first-inference (median): 4m 20s (includes deps + env setup)
- Number of unique issues filed during session: 7 (linked above / LIN-1337)

Notes to self / informal: 
- Keep the quickstart script minimal — heavy reliance on docker adds overhead for non-docker devs. Maybe ship two modes (docker / local).
- Consider a tiny troubleshooting CLI command: `rw-dev doctor` to surface common misconfigs. Put on backlog.

Action items (concrete):
- Priya: draft TL;DR checklist + auth quickref (2026-11-18)
- Ethan: open follow-up PR to add log level flags and prune noisy debug messages (2026-11-16)
- Liam: fix empty-index bug + test; add a short entry in samples README (2026-11-15)
__notes_internal: playtest doc, working record; will be refined into a final beta playbook after follow-ups
